transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me a little bit about what has been bothering you and what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here today because I've been struggling a lot with constant fidgeting and restlessness. I feel like I'm always "on the go" and just can't seem to sit still. It's really starting to make it hard for me to focus on my daily tasks.

Do you find that this difficulty in focusing is primarily due to your restlessness, or do you also frequently struggle with being forgetful, losing things, or failing to pay close attention to details?

It's definitely a mix of both. I constantly feel restless and fidgety, almost like I'm driven by a motor and always have to be on the go. While I don't really struggle with losing things or being forgetful, I definitely make a lot of careless mistakes because I fail to pay close attention to details.
Besides making careless mistakes, do you often find it difficult to sustain your attention when listening to others or when you are working on longer, more boring tasks?

Yes, I definitely find it really hard to stay focused when people are speaking directly to me. I often feel like I completely zone out and just don't register what they are saying, even if I'm trying to pay attention.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports significant symptoms of both hyperactivity/impulsivity (restlessness, 'on the go') and inattentiveness (making careless mistakes, difficulty sustaining attention during conversations). As the patient meets criteria for both domains, the diagnosis is narrowed to the Combined Presentation.
